en: A vintage black-and-white postcard showing a street view with a notable two-story house, likely of historical significance. Several people are standing or walking near the house, which features shuttered windows and a gated entrance. The top left corner has an illustration resembling a medallion or plaque with a profile portrait and the inscription 'Geoffroy Saint-Hilaire.' The top of the card contains French text referencing 'Étampes' and 'Maison où naquit Geoffroy Saint-Hilaire.' The general visual style and attire of the people suggest an early 20th-century date.
